headline:
When The Clocks Go Back
Check Your Smoke Alarms
titan_line: Echo, clocks go back one hour on Sunday, November 1. The U.S. Fire Administration has a few simple steps for smoke alarms.
rows: Smoke alarms get tested monthly, says the U.S. Fire Administration. Your fire department can say more.
Batteries yearly, the whole alarm every 10 years, per the U.S. Fire Administration. Ask your fire department.
Alarms go inside and outside each bedroom and on every level. A licensed electrician can check hardwired ones.
echo_line: Once a month? …Oh. I only check mine when the clocks change. I'd start this weekend.
source: U.S. Fire Administration, Smoke Alarms · Fox 29, clock change date · read October 23, 2026
disclaimer: General fire-safety information, not an inspection or advice about any home. Ask your local fire department about yours.
